redBaseline.why: Failures came from the new screen assertions, not from infrastructure. auth.setup.ts passed and 8 pre-existing tests stayed green.

failures.C3c: Expected "rgb(0, 7, 12)" Received "rgb(11, 15, 18)" — panel background still the invented value
failures.C3d: Expected "rgba(255, 234, 158, 0.2)" Received "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)" — selected option had no background
failures.C3e: Expected focused Received inactive — opening the panel moved focus nowhere

commands.summary: TypeScript clean after the post-review purity fix.

ESLint clean. Orchestrator fixed one error the tester left behind: the C3c/C3d/C3e helper declared 'page: any', tripping @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any; replaced with 'type Page' from @playwright/test.
Production build clean. Route table renders /, /_not-found, /auth/callback, /login, /todo plus the proxy middleware.
11/11 pass. The three formerly-RED cases C3c, C3d, C3e are green on the identical command that produced the RED.
Full suite 23/23 pass across setup + anon + authed, re-run after the post-review fix. No regression in C1, C2, C3, C3b, C4, C5, C10 or the authenticated specs.

visualValidation.note: The tester agent reported visual validation but produced no images — its capture-dropdown.mjs called browser.createContext(), which is not a Playwright API (correct call is newContext), so the script failed silently and only CSS assertions ran. The stray script was removed and screenshots were re-captured with the project's own bundled chromium.
